quests.title: Narcissus's Waltz

dialogue.t: Seymour! It's been so long! And Mamere too!
Hehe, Seymour wouldn't stop telling me how much he missed you.
Affirmative. I never stopped thinking of Miss Mary-Ann.
And thank you, Miss Sandrone, for hosting this tea party. It's so nice to get together and chat about our travels.
Don't mention it. I feel like we're all family on some level, with a long, shared history. Uhm, at least that's how I see it. So there's no harm in getting together when everyone's free.
Family? I don't know why, but hearing you say that fills me with joy.
So does that make Miss Sandrone our... little sister?
Uhm... Maybe we can skip the whole big, little thing for now...?
Affirmative. As the prototype created by Mr. Alain, Miss Sandrone should properly address me as "Big Brother."
Hmph...
Aw, that's so lovely. Can I be a member of this family, too?
Of course! We're hardly a conventional "family" to begin with. What harm could adding a Melusine to the mix do?
Affirmative. Besides, Miss Mamere is already my family.
Hehe. This makes me so happy! How about I paint us all a family portrait?
A family portrait? It's been a long time since I posed for one of those...
Make sure to make me look impressive! Like the big sister of the family!
Sure thing!
Heh... Why not?
Such a peaceful, pleasant day.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Mmhmm, thank you for the invitation, Sandrone... Or should I call you "little sister"?

quests.description: Go to the hidden dwelling, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests…
